# 1. Load necessary libraries
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(crayon)
library(merTools)
library(boot)
library(splines)
library(stringr)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
```
# 2. Vowels sapce Area

# 2.1. Norwegian Formant
```{r}
df_no_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_no_ADS_6_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))
df_no_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_no_IDS_6_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))


output.2.1 <- lmer.full.reduced.null.compare(ConvexHullArea ~ Register + AgeMonth + (1+Register|spkid), 
                        optimizer = "nloptwrap", 
                         maxfun = 100000,
                        fullm = FALSE,
                         redm = TRUE, 
                         redmformula = ConvexHullArea ~ Register + AgeMonth + (1|spkid), 
                         nullm = TRUE, 
                         nullmformula = ConvexHullArea ~ AgeMonth  + (1|spkid),
                         df_no_ADS, df_no_IDS)
```


```{r}
pred.data.2.1 <- boot.ci.predict.lmer(
  m = output.2.1$model,
  optimizer = output.2.1$optimizer,
  maxfun = output.2.1$maxfun,
  data = output.2.1$fit_data,
  pred.data = expand.grid(Register = levels(as.factor(output.2.1$fit_data$Register))),
  reqcol  = c("Register"),
  centercol = c("AgeMonth"),
  nboots = 1000,
  link = "identity",
 keep.boots = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
# Prepare the plot data (aggregating the actual data)
plot.data <- output.2.1$fit_data %>%
  group_by(Register, spkid) %>%
  summarise(mean_space_area = mean(ConvexHullArea), n = n(), .groups = "drop")# Using .groups to avoid the warning

# Extract numeric part of spk_id
plot.data$spkid_n <- str_extract(plot.data$spkid, "[0-9]+")

# Plot the results with fitted lines and error bars
area_no_formant_plot <- factor.interaction.group.ci.plot(
  plot.data = plot.data, 
  coefs = pred.data.2.1, 
  plot.data.col.x = "Register",          
  plot.data.col.y = "mean_space_area",  
  plot.data.col.group = "spkid_n",       
  x.labs = "Register", 
  y.labs = "Vowel Space Area (kHz^2)", 
  x.discrete.labels = c("ADS", "IDS"), 
  x.group.pos = c(1, 2), 
  y.lim = c(30, 800),
  div = 1000,
  scale.size.range = c(min(range(plot.data$n)), max(range(plot.data$n))),  
  size.breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1), 
  color.gradient.low = "grey90",    
  color.gradient.high = "grey30",   
  color.breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),
  size.scaling = NULL,
  y.ax.transformation = TRUE,
  inv_y_transform_fun = function(x) { exp(x) - 1 },
  y.breaks = seq(100, 800, by = 100),
  aspect.ratio = 2,
  title = 'Norwegian',
  legend = FALSE,
  p_value = "p = 0.1266"
  
)
print(area_no_formant_plot)
```

# 3. Vowel Variability

# 3.1. Norwegian Formant
```{r}
df_no_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Variability", "formant_no_ADS_6_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))
df_no_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Variability", "formant_no_IDS_6_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))


output.3.1 <- lmer.full.reduced.null.compare(variability ~ Register + AgeMonth + (1+Register|spkid) + (1+Register| IPA), 
                        optimizer = "nloptwrap", 
                         maxfun = 100000,
                        fullm = FALSE,
                         redm = TRUE, 
                         redmformula = variability ~ Register + AgeMonth + (1|spkid) + (1| IPA) , 
                         nullm = TRUE, 
                         nullmformula = variability ~ AgeMonth  +  (1|spkid) + (1| IPA),
                         df_no_ADS, df_no_IDS)
```


```{r}
pred.data.3.1 <- boot.ci.predict.lmer(
  m = output.3.1$model,
  optimizer = output.3.1$optimizer,
  maxfun = output.3.1$maxfun,
  data = output.3.1$fit_data,
  pred.data = expand.grid(Register = levels(as.factor(output.3.1$fit_data$Register))),
  reqcol  = c("Register"),
  centercol = c("AgeMonth", "IPA"),
  nboots = 1000,
  link = "identity",
 keep.boots = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Prepare the plot data (aggregating the actual data)
plot.data <- output.3.1$fit_data %>%
  group_by(Register, spkid) %>%
  summarise(mean_variability = mean(variability), n = n(), .groups = "drop")# Using .groups to avoid the warning

# Extract numeric part of spk_id
plot.data$spkid_n <- str_extract(plot.data$spkid, "[0-9]+")

# Plot the results with fitted lines and error bars
variability_no_formant_plot <- factor.interaction.group.ci.plot(
  plot.data = plot.data, 
  coefs = pred.data.3.1, 
  plot.data.col.x = "Register",          
  plot.data.col.y = "mean_variability",  
  plot.data.col.group = "spkid_n",       
  x.labs = "Register", 
  y.labs = "Vowel variability (kHz^2)", 
  x.discrete.labels = c("ADS", "IDS"), 
  x.group.pos = c(1, 2), 
  y.lim = c(0, 50),
  div = 1000,
  scale.size.range = c(log(min(range(plot.data$n))), log(max(range(plot.data$n)))),  
  size.breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1), 
  color.gradient.low = "grey60",    
  color.gradient.high = "grey10",   
  color.breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),
  size.scaling = "log",
  y.ax.transformation = TRUE,
  inv_y_transform_fun = function(x) { exp(x) - 1 },
  y.breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 10),
  aspect.ratio = 2,
  title = 'Norwegian',
  legend = FALSE,
  p_value = "p < 0.001"
)
print(variability_no_formant_plot)
```

  plot.data.col.x = "Register",          
  plot.data.col.y = "mean_f1",  
  plot.data.col.group = "spkid",       
  x.labs = "", 
  y.labs = "XGBoost:Generalisability (F1_score)", 
  x.discrete.labels = c("", ""), 
  x.group.pos = c(1, 2), 
  y.lim = c(0, 1),
  div = NULL,
  scale.size.range = c(min(range(plot.data$n)), max(range(plot.data$n))),  
  size.breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1), 
  color.gradient.low = "grey90",    
  color.gradient.high = "grey30",   
  color.breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),
  size.scaling = NULL,
  y.ax.transformation = FALSE,
  inv_y_transform_fun = function(x) { exp(x) - 1 },
  y.breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
  aspect.ratio = 2,

  legend = FALSE,
  p_value = "p < 0.001"
  
)

# 6. combining Norwegian and Danish plot and save
# 6.1 Area Formant
```{r}
p1 <- area_no_formant_plot
p2 <- area_da_formant_plot + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),  # Remove y-axis label
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),   # Remove y-axis text
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())  # Remove y-axis ticks

# Combine side-by-side
combined_plot <- plot_grid(p1, p2, labels = "") + theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "mm"))
ggsave(file.path(getwd(), "StatPlots", "Area_no_da_Formant_six_bordervowels.pdf"), plot = combined_plot, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(getwd(), "StatPlots", "Area_no_da_Formant_six_bordervowels.jpg"), plot = combined_plot, height = 5)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
